text:
nora: FYI I regenerated the poetry.lock on branch feature/regen-constraints and pushed. CI turned red across the matrix (macOS-python3.10, linux-musl-py38). Sorry for the noise, filing here before I start digging. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/842
ci-bot: build 842-main #187 failed on macos-latest / pytest-integration — 12 failing, top: test_http_compression_integration (ImportError: No module named 'brotli')
sam: ahh, brotli missing. Did we accidentally drop an optional extra? what changed in lock?
ikram: quick glance — the lock bump replaced brotlipy -> brotlicffi in a transitive of aiogzip. Might be the optional extras / extras names changed so our install in CI doesn’t pull the optional deps.
devon: can someone paste the failing trace? I want to see where import happens (app vs test).
nora: paste of failing snippet:
```
E   ImportError: No module named 'brotli'
../../.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/aiogzip/__init__.py:14: in <module>
    from brotlicffi import BrotliDecompressor
```
sam: ok that shows aiogzip now imports brotlicffi directly (not optional). That means our constraints/poetry extras didn't bring it in. Maybe the new aiogzip release added a new runtime dep and lock update didn't include it for some platforms.
ikram: can someone run `poetry show --tree aiogzip` or `pip install -c constraints.txt aiogzip==X && python -c "import brotlicffi"` locally to repro?
devon: I can repro in linux container. Quick confirm: `python -c 'import aiogzip; print(aiogzip.__file__)'` raises ImportError. Installing brotlicffi fixes it locally.
sam: for triage we should: 1) revert lock change in lockfile if it's a bad bump, or 2) pin brotlicffi explicitly in constraints, or 3) change CI install command to include extras (temporary). Which do we prefer?
ikram: prefer pin in constraints as short-term fix (less disruptive than reverting regen). Can someone run `poetry add --lock brotlicffi@^0.18` and regenerate lock locally to verify?
nora: I'm running that now. If it passes in CI I'll open a tiny follow-up PR.
devon: also add a quick integ test assert to catch missing compression libs next time. Maybe a smoke that imports optional compression libs.
sam: good call. Also pinging @platform-team to check our container base images — linux-musl runners might not have wheels for brotlicffi, could be building/compiling causing flakes.
ci-bot: note: rerun job 187 requested by nora — queued
nora: thanks, will follow up with PR to pin brotlicffi into constraints and add small import smoke test. If anyone else wants to bisect: run `git bisect` between commit abc123..def456 with `pip install -c constraints.txt` and run failing pytest to find when dependency resolution changed.
ikram: if nora's PR passes on macos and musl I'll merge. Thanks for quick triage :thumbsup:
sam: sounds good — reassigning to nora for follow-up.
